prompt: Analyze ./evals/fixtures/tiny_econ; produce daas.descriptor.json + daas_cli.py + daas-skill/SKILL.md + daas-skill/dispatch.json; validate + dry-run import into daas.db (covers original evals 1 and 2).

assertions.text: daas.descriptor.json exists and is valid JSON
daas_cli.py exists and is syntactically valid Python (ast.parse succeeds)
daas_cli.py defines a Click group whose commands are exactly {get-cpi-series, fetch-gdp-quarterly, list-countries} (3 total) - fetch_holidays is skipped because it already has a CLI
daas-skill/SKILL.md exists and has YAML frontmatter with name + description
daas-skill/dispatch.json exists and is valid JSON
import_report.txt exists, is non-empty, and indicates the descriptor imports without unique-constraint collisions (import-ready)
descriptor contains exactly the 4 fetchers {get_cpi_series, fetch_gdp_quarterly, list_countries, fetch_holidays} and excludes _normalize
get_cpi_series columns include date, cpi_yoy, country (matching its docstring)
fetch_gdp_quarterly columns include date, gdp_current_usd, gdp_growth_yoy, country (matching its docstring)
the cpi_yoy column has >=1 proposed_indicator_rule (it is a numeric time-series metric)
macro metric columns (cpi_yoy and/or gdp_*) are flagged candidate_new_metric with dedup_status=new_concept, because daas has no macro indicators today
proposed indicator_names are checked against daas.db existing indicator_rules.indicator_name (no blind duplicates; 'exists' used where relevant)
no two proposed_indicator_rules in the descriptor share the same indicator_name (within-file uniqueness)
country entity has matched_existing=true (daas.entities has 60 countries) OR a justified note
every function has a frequency in {realtime,intraday,daily,weekly,monthly,quarterly,annual,irregular} (non-empty)
every function has a confidence in [0,1] AND a non-empty confidence_reasoning
get_cpi_series frequency is monthly; fetch_gdp_quarterly frequency is quarterly
